tests.title: «Ir al contenido» is the first stop and skips the menu
the whole menu is reachable with Tab and every stop shows its focus
tablet drawer: opens with Enter, closes with Escape and returns focus
context selector traps focus, closes with Escape and returns focus
unsaved changes: Escape keeps editing and the typed data stays
wizard: errors are announced and focus moves to the step, all by keyboard
audit filters: labelled fields reachable in order and applied with Enter
